name: New Bark Cave + Free Shop
description: A compact shop in the cave's northwest corner leaves room for future town buildings. Two clerks behind the counter offer all seven reusable HMs and free supplies: Potions, Full Restore, Revive, Full Heal, and Poké/Great/Ultra/Master Balls. Everything costs ¥0 with normal quantities and bag limits. Includes all earlier cave, starter and EXP-option features.
notes: Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading. Older cave saves in the new building footprint move safely to its front door; other positions and save layout are preserved. Field HMs still need their normal badges. Stock is unlimited; other marts keep normal prices. Saves inside this shop need v1.5+. Use CONTINUE, not a numbered state from another ROM. Complete playthrough remains unverified.
